mechanism_narrative: A lower level of the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) relative to its long-term average is associated with positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days, as it reduces the cost of capital for corporations and increases the present value of future cash flows.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 2.5%, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A labor market weakness, indicated by an unemployment rate above 5.5%, signals potential economic slowdown and reduced corporate earnings growth, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE exceeds 5.5%, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous expansion in housing starts (HOUST) above 1050 thousand units and retail sales (RSAFS) above 380,000 million dollars signals robust consumer demand and economic growth, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when both HOUST exceeds 1050 and RSAFS exceeds 380000, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In periods of high inflation (CPIAUCSL above 215), the Federal Reserve is expected to tighten monetary policy, which increases discount rates and reduces equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL exceeds 215, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A higher level of industrial production (INDPRO) relative to its historical average indicates strong manufacturing activity and economic expansion, which supports corporate earnings and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO is above its 5-year average, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in non-farm payrolls below 137,000 thousand persons signals weak labor market conditions and reduced consumer spending power, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when PAYEMS is below 137000, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS < 2.5%) and high inflation (CPIAUCSL > 215) signals a 'stagflation' risk, where the Federal Reserve is constrained from easing policy due to inflation, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS < 2.5 and CPIAUCSL > 215, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion phase (GDPC1 above 11700 billion dollars), the economy is near its peak, which often precedes a slowdown, but the current strong growth supports corporate earnings and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when GDPC1 exceeds 11700, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.
